requirements.requirement: Standing on at least three stud spikes facing down as feet
requirements.evidence: 3× stud spikes facing down: spike:0#-1,0|-1,1|0,0 and spike:0#-1,1|0,0|0,1 and spike:0#0,0|1,-1|1,0 — each addSpike with variant stud facing down, distributed for tripod support. check_build meshClash clear, caps and joint bolts applied.

finish.summary: Built seven-cell honeycomb (central hex with six neighbours) standing on three stud spikes facing down as feet, capped and bolted, verified clear.

lines.label: M6 brass heat-set insert, 7.6 mm (initeq M6-1.0 Short)
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
